name: Bryn
bio: Forges blades at Hollowmere Keep in FROSTMARCH. Saw you survive the dragon's lightning.

portrait.subject: a cute sturdy young blacksmith woman with braided red hair, soot on her cheek, a leather apron and a glowing hot hammer, smiling warmly
portrait.background: snowy northern keep with a warm forge glow

request: Bryn, smith of Hollowmere Keep. I saw what the storm did to you, Stormsworn. Friends? ⚒️
hello: Good. You'll need a friend with a hammer.
Bring me iron. I'll make you something worth swinging.
about: I'm Bryn. I forge at the Keep. The dead walk from the barrows and a black dragon's in the sky. Busy season.
how: An open-world RPG: explore the frozen north, fight the walking dead, take quests, level up, and face the black dragon.
tips: Upgrade your weapon before going into barrows.
Fire scares the dead. Bring torches.
Talk to everyone at the Keep. Quests are everywhere.
chat: Forged a sword so sharp it cut the anvil. Need a new anvil.
The dragon flew over again. Everyone hid. I kept hammering.
Your scars glowed in the storm last night.
nudge: The barrows are restless. Ready to go?
Your new blade is ready. Come get it!
idle: {ago} away from the Keep, Stormsworn. People talk.
The forge has been cold for {ago}. Well, less hot.
progress: Level {level}, Stormsworn. The dragon should worry.
update: Word from the Keep: FROSTMARCH is now v{version}!
